transcript.text:
Thank you all for those critical findings. Let me summarize what I'm hearing before I make a decision:

1. From Victor (maintenance): The V-12 camera mount only fits Cell 7's 6 mm bracket pattern — Cell 3 is not viable. Installation at Cell 7 requires 4 hours and isolation of 3 electrical points. This detail is in the commissioning file but hasn't made it into the work-order summary yet.

2. From Elena (quality): The customer validation appendix requires 30 signed reference samples and challenge testing on 100 consecutive production pieces. The quality checklist hasn't been updated yet to reflect these requirements.

3. From Ravi (safety): The access-door interlock must go through 6 open-and-trip cycles with results recorded in an interlock test record. The permit draft doesn't yet contain this requirement.

Based on Victor's finding, the installation cell decision is clear — it has to be Cell 7. However, I am not prepared to authorize commissioning this weekend until three things happen:

- Victor's fit-up findings need to be incorporated into the work-order summary so the full scope (4 hours, 3 electrical isolation points) is documented.
- Elena, the quality checklist must be revised to include the 30 reference samples and 100-piece challenge test before we proceed.
- Ravi, the permit needs to be updated with the 6-cycle interlock test requirement and your walkdown notes.

Once those three updates are complete and circulated, I can approve the work order. Can each of you confirm you can get those updates done before the weekend? If so, I'll authorize commissioning at Cell 7.
